title: Playboy April 2007 Ashley Massaro WWE Diva Bill Maher Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover has a crease line across the lower right corner (see close-up). Back cover has light scuffing and corner wear. Spine intact.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, April 2007. Original $6.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: WWE Diva Ashley Massaro.

Cover features: Kickin' Ashley plus a 4-page bonus featuring the women of the WWE - Chyna, Torrie, Sable and more; foreign Playmates; Bill Maher interview; the burglar and the mob boss; fiction by Nadine Gordimer; the brave new world of HGH; fantasy golf weekends; best new fashion.

Back cover: Caravelle by Bulova watch ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
